scientific_status.reason: Both external-provider attempts failed before the first scored response because the provider returned HTTP 429. The second attempt failed on B1 stage 0 with a 6,390-character prompt after bounded 30/60/120-second retries, so the failure cannot be attributed to the 4,000-event full-history context.

frozen_design.b1: complete ordered public history without truncation
frozen_design.b3: latest public semantic state per key derived from the identical public history

attempts.diagnosis: Checkout, SSH transport and pack construction succeeded. Provider execution failed with HTTP 429 before a complete scored response set was produced.

The same provider HTTP 429 persisted across all bounded retries on the first stage-0 call. Because stage 0 contains no 4,000-event history and the prompt is only 6,390 characters, this run provides evidence of provider availability/quota throttling, not evidence of full-history context failure.

claim_boundary: Do not count either failed workflow as B1 or B3 task failure.
Do not treat HTTP 429 as evidence that B1 cannot process the 4,000-event history.
Do not revise the completed Experiment 2 B1/B3 accuracy conclusion from these attempts.
Only a successful run that emits raw responses, deterministic scores, manifest, artifact ID and digest may establish an Experiment 3 cognitive result.
